criteria.published: Main PDF pp.18-21, §5.1-5.2, Proposition 3, Proposition 4, Theorem 4 and all-workers C-cardinal boundary; Appendix PDF p.22 proof of Theorem 4.

criteria.reason: Correct sufficient own-worker effective-price reparametrization. No universal necessity, C-cardinal all-workers exception, or joint-salary-tax counterexample.
